recovery_policy: An unresolved .thresher-old-* sibling blocks build; never auto-adopt or delete it. Inspect and explicitly restore it to an absent original output, or relocate it for safekeeping. Backups are deleted only after successful replacement.
scope_limitation: Simulated rename/cleanup exceptions in temporary fixture directories; no real user installation or adversarial concurrent-path race test.
